text: Migration on branch migrate/fmri-frame: R/, tests/, vignettes/, man/, DESCRIPTION (fmridataset >= 0.10.0.9000), NEWS done; NAMESPACE now imports only fmri_frame, collect_assay, temporal_schema, as_sampling_frame (the as.matrix_dataset lazy-load failure is gone); src/ols_t.cpp unused-variable warning fixed. New R/fmri_frame_helpers.R provides matrix_frame(), neurovec_frame(), nifti_frame(), latent_frame() plus internal .dset_* accessors over the frame API. Defect found and fixed while verifying: all three matrix-backed constructors passed the caller's matrix through with its dimnames intact, which fmri_frame() rejects as a second unchecked naming of axes whose IDs the constructor generates (fmridataset_error_alignment). Any prcomp output (PC1..PCr) or neuroim2::series() result therefore failed; latent_frame() now adopts usable component names as the component IDs and every constructor drops non-authoritative dimnames. Regression tests in tests/testthat/test-frame-constructors.R.
